minimal_adapter_contract.step_1_unrank: Unrank terminal_rank to the exact 11 known-label pairing values and replay rank(unrank(rank)) identity.

minimal_adapter_contract.step_3_projection: For each exact Picard64 completion candidate, compute the rank-5 Reynolds projection coordinate z with the retained 21ak translation data.
minimal_adapter_contract.step_4_59d_model: Instantiate only the generic x0(z)+K*t, t in Z^59 pairing inequalities/integrality model. Do not import fixed-projection 21az prism/bands.
minimal_adapter_contract.step_5_sat_output: If SAT, emit exact witness_r_reduced[59] plus row_id,d,e,terminal_rank,terminal_pairings,z and all source locks.
minimal_adapter_contract.step_6_consumer: Feed the witness into stages/stage32-ex5/breadth-cycle-2/bc2_02_exact_witness_to_node_support.py and retain exact 48-node support/span output.
